findings.finding: Commercial tour URLs earn almost no Search clicks; discovery is concentrated on homepage + informational blogs.
findings.evidence: GSC 2026-08-02→09-02: ATV tour 12 imp/0 clk; cycling 2/0; cooking 1/0; rafting 12/0; homepage 79/10. Chart totals 20 clicks / 455 impressions.
findings.impact: Money keywords are not converting discoverability into booked-intent traffic.
findings.fix: Push internal links + CTR from ranking blogs into /tours/bali-atv-adventure, /tours/ubud-ricefield-cycling-tour, /tours/balinese-cooking-class; expand commercial hub content with unique operator facts.

findings.finding: High-impression blogs still show 0% CTR in the audited GSC window (pre-rewrite baseline).
findings.evidence: temple-dress 69 imp/0 clk/pos 27.6; airport-transfer 69/0/pos 60.7. Live titles now 50/48 chars after 2026-09-05 rewrites — CTR impact not yet in this export.
findings.impact: Wasted impressions and weak funnel into commercial pages.
findings.fix: Monitor next 14–28 days CTR; if still <2%, A/B stronger benefit-led titles and add early WhatsApp/tour CTAs.

findings.finding: Multiple blog posts remain below the 1,500-word quality gate and several titles exceed ~60 characters.
findings.evidence: Live parse: private-atv-vs-mass 400w/title 94; luwak ethical 360w/title 94; cycling-worth-it 440w/title 87; ATV cost 567w/title 93. Temple dress improved to 909w.
findings.impact: Thin posts struggle for competitive informational queries; long titles truncate in SERPs.
findings.fix: Either deepen top commercial spokes to 1,200–1,500+ with first-hand Pejeng/operator detail, or consolidate/prune thin non-converting posts. Shorten titles to ≤60 with brand at end.

findings.finding: Depth-1 crawl still finds many near-orphan blog URLs (≤1 inbound internal link).
findings.evidence: internal_links.py: 15 potential orphans including pejeng history, subak, spices, luwak, itinerary posts. orphan_pages_from_sitemap depth-1: 31 sitemap URLs not reached (includes blogs + policy pages).
findings.impact: Crawl equity and topical authority do not flow to spokes or back to money pages.
findings.fix: From /blog index + related posts, add 2–3 contextual links per orphan; ensure every commercial spoke links to its tour money page.

findings.finding: Several meta descriptions exceed 160 characters (likely SERP truncation).
findings.evidence: book 198; blog index 184; ATV-cost 185; cycling-worth-it 189; private-atv 183; is-ubud meta 189.
findings.fix: Cap seoDescription / excerpts at ≤155–160 characters on those templates.

findings.finding: Brand query 'sekar bali' ranks but earned 0 clicks in the window.
findings.evidence: GSC query: sekar bali — 8 impressions, position 6.9, 0 clicks.
findings.impact: Brand SERP underperformance; possible title/snippet or Knowledge Panel competition.
findings.fix: Align GBP + Organization alternateName; ensure homepage title leads with brand; review sitelinks/snippet; gather reviews/sameAs.

findings.finding: Dirt-bike tour page gets more impressions than core ATV/cycling money pages but 0 clicks.
findings.evidence: GSC: /tours/bali-dirt-bike-adventure 32 imp / 0 clk / pos 24.1 vs ATV 12/0.
findings.impact: SERP attention on a peripheral offer may dilute commercial focus.
findings.fix: Improve CTR with clearer offer title or noindex/prune if non-core; ensure ATV/cycling outrank it for adventure intent.

findings.finding: Core Web Vitals could not be confirmed this run.
findings.evidence: pagespeed.py rate-limited twice by Google API (no key).
findings.fix: Re-run pagespeed.py with PSI API key; optimize hero LCP candidate (/images/adventures/hero-banner.jpg via next/image).

findings.finding: HTTP apex uses a 2-hop redirect chain to https www.
findings.impact: Minor crawl/latency inefficiency; GSC still recorded some http:// rows.
findings.fix: Prefer single hop http+apex → https://www directly if DNS/hosting allows.

findings.impact: None for EN-only local tour site.
findings.fix: Only add hreflang if launching localized locales.

findings.finding: Crawlability and security baseline are strong.
findings.evidence: robots 200 with AI bots allowed; sitemap.xml 53 URLs; HTTPS+HSTS preload; CSP/XFO/nosniff/Referrer/Permissions; security score 100; broken_links 0 broken; apex/www 308 redirects.
findings.fix: Keep disallowing /admin/ and /api/; maintain single sitemap.xml declaration (ignore checker 404s for unused sitemap_index.xml).

findings.finding: llms.txt / llms-full.txt / pricing.md are present and high quality.
findings.fix: Keep price/NAP facts synchronized with tours.ts and GBP.

findings.finding: LocalBusiness/TravelAgency, TouristTrip with Offer, Product ItemList, BreadcrumbList, and standalone Question/Answer present; no FAQPage/HowTo.
findings.evidence: Homepage + ATV/cycling tour JSON-LD type inventory; GSC Search appearance shows Product snippets (5 imp).
findings.impact: Eligible for product/offer understanding; FAQ rich results correctly not pursued.
findings.fix: Optional: add sku-like tour identifiers on Product nodes; skip shippingDetails (not applicable to local tours).

findings.finding: Homepage title/meta/OG/Twitter within healthy ranges; images have alt text.
findings.evidence: title 43 chars; meta 148; social_meta 92/100; image_inventory missing_alt=0 on homepage and audited tours.
findings.impact: Solid sharing and basic on-page hygiene.
